items.title: GM Slides 7% From a 52-Week High as New York Files Its $220 Million Driver Data Settlement
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors fell 7% in two days from a 52-week high as New York filed its share of a $220 million driver data settlement. New York’s attorney general said GM’s OnStar app told more than 370,000 drivers they weren’t enrolled while GM collected and sold their data.
